title: Bib Collection Readiness Status Breakdown
dataSources: Race results (`raceresult:event`), TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), marathon splits (`race:split`), bib pickup and race logistics (`race:bib`).
app: Race result APIs, TrainingPeaks workouts and TSS, marathon split exports, and bib-collection checklists streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted REST inputs, CSV imports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=race:bib
| stats count as items by pickup_status
| eventstats sum(items) as total
| eval pct=round(100*items/total,1)
| sort - items
description: Shows the current mix of bib collection readiness records by status so blocked or incomplete work stands out quickly.
value: A status split is the fastest way to explain the shape of the queue without reading every record.
implementation: Keep status names small and well controlled so the split is readable and action-oriented.
visualization: Pie chart or bar chart of current records by status.
grandmaExplanation: It frames how your bib pickups are spread across waiting, done, and stuck states.
